purpose: Teach: ウイング/システムズ/サイボウズ/光文社/ウンコ/丸出し/細木/小田急

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがサッカーのウイング選手をご贔屓だった
lines.en: Gran, you know your father was mad about soccer wingers back when he was young.
lines.style: Gentle, reaching backward into memory. Soft opening, as if touching something precious. Unhurried pace, letting each image settle. Voice stays warm and low.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、IT企業のシステムズ系で働かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you worked in systems at an IT company back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Knowing smile in the voice. Matching his nostalgic beat but with a turn—she's redirecting gently, playfully. Warm, familiar. The tone of a wife who's heard these stories a hundred times.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがサイボウズの初期株主だった
lines.en: Gran, your father was one of the early shareholders in Cybozu back when all that was happening.
lines.style: Another quiet memory surfaces. Slight pause before the name—a moment of pride. Voice stays gentle and unhurried, as if letting the weight of it rest there.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、光文社の小説を蔵書されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you collected novels from Kobunsha back in those days, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: A knowing tilt in her voice now. She's gently steering him again, naming his own small passions back to him. Warm and slightly mischievous—she's leading him somewhere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお孫様の「ウンコ」期を可愛がられた
lines.en: Gran, your father was so patient with your grandson through that silly 'unko' phase.
lines.style: Voice softens into something almost childlike with affection. A small laugh lives at the edges of this memory. The pace is slower, tender. As if the absurdity itself is what he treasures.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、夏に「腹丸出しで寝る癖」があったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you—you'd sleep half-naked in summer, belly out, wouldn't you, dear?
lines.style: A laugh in her delivery now. Teasing but without edge. She says it like she's caught him in something ridiculous and wonderful. Warmth mixed with dry affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが細木数子氏の占い番組を観られた
lines.en: Gran, your father would watch that fortune-telling show with Hosoki Kazuko back then.
lines.style: Voice holds a hint of sheepishness mixed with nostalgia. The memory is a little embarrassing, a little endearing. Soft tempo, like he's admitting something small and real.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、小田急ロマンスカーで箱根に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you took the Odakyu Romance Car out to Hakone, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Her voice is closest to him now—intimate, teasing, affectionate. The words are almost whispered with shared history. A small laugh underneath. This one lands differently—warmer, more personal.
